name: United States
declaringWar: I don't want war, but sometimes we have to.
attacked: You dare stand in the way of the United States? I will bomb you to hell!
defeated: Congratulations. Instead of the United States of America... Your nation will go far.
introduction: Welcome to the United States of America. If you conduct yourself well, you can consider us friends.

name: Russian Federation
declaringWar: It's time for us to go to war. We will be there in parade uniforms!
attacked: Your war is futile. It's impossible to invade Russia! Whoever will come to us with a sword, from a sword will perish!
defeated: I am defeated. To live one's life is not like crossing a field.
introduction: Hello, I am Vladimir Putin. A worthy ruler such as yourself must appreciate all the most exquisite things, yes?
tradeRequest: How would you like it if I propose this kind of exchange?

name: United Kingdom
declaringWar: It is always unfortunate when words fail. Fortunately, we have prepared for that possibility.
defeated: Well, this is embarrassing. Still, one mustn't dwell.
introduction: It is quite nice to meet you. I am Andy Burnham, Prime Minister of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.
tradeRequest: Let us attempt something increasingly rare in international affairs: a mutually sensible agreement.
